subject: Expand visual-learning source discovery beyond DESIGN.md and learn from rendered evidence
parent_goal: Doré autonomous visual learning and New Westside visual quality
premise: Doré's learning architecture is already beyond static markdown memory: research evidence, Storybook specimens/candidates, browser render evidence, visual judgment, durable learning, provenance, baseline immutability, WESTSIDE_FIT and product promotion are separate stages. DESIGN.md is therefore an input/reference format, not the learning system itself.

seed_resources.role: large catalog of real-product DESIGN.md analyses; use as searchable reference direction
URL/screenshot to DESIGN.md plus live preview; study evidence extraction
deterministic extraction of colors/type/spacing/radii/components; inspect reproducible pipeline
directory of examples/templates/design skills and agent workflows
community design-system library; useful for broad pattern discovery, not authority
open-source live-browser measurement of computed visual system including breakpoints/motion/interaction states
open DESIGN.md creator skill and preview artifacts; inspect method rather than copy styles
curated agent-readable visual directions and format examples

search_expansion_required: Find substantially more VISUAL-FIRST sources beyond DESIGN.md: high-quality editorial sites, digital magazines, cultural institutions, architecture/arts sites, experimental typography, motion/WebGL sites, award-winning web design, interaction galleries, design-system showcases, component-pattern libraries, responsive layout references, and real production sites.
Prefer sources with actual rendered pages, interaction, motion, responsive states, screenshots/video/browser-inspectable evidence over text-only commentary.
Build source families instead of one flat bookmark list; score sources for visual distinctiveness, evidence accessibility, transferability to Westside, and risk of generic SaaS contamination.
For every useful source, extract observations into reusable structured knowledge and test at least selected high-value patterns through Storybook/browser specimens.

Reject superficial copying. Learn composition grammar, hierarchy, typography behavior, image treatment, spatial rhythm, navigation, motion timing, responsive transformation, materiality, editorial density and interaction principles.
learning_pipeline: DECOMPOSE visual grammar and implementation evidence
STORE structured durable knowledge with provenance/confidence
VERIFY in real browser desktop/mobile including motion where applicable
COMPARE against locked Westside baseline and identity invariants
PROMOTE only evidence-backed knowledge/patterns; otherwise reject or keep experimental
REUSE learned knowledge in New Westside without blind duplicate research
priority_visual_dimensions: serif/display typography and bilingual Chinese/English hierarchy
materiality: paper, stone, dawn light, archival print
WebGL only where meaningfully useful rather than decorative
responsive transformation from desktop to mobile

pass_requires: expanded source map with multiple visual-first families
actual rendered evidence for representative sources
structured observations with provenance and confidence
at least one new Storybook/browser experiment derived from newly discovered visual sources
downstream reuse path into active New Westside parent goal
